initiatives.name: Schumacher Packaging Western Europe Acquisition
initiatives.summary: Mondi completed the acquisition of Schumacher Packaging's Western Europe Packaging Assets in April 2025. The acquisition strengthens Mondi's corrugated solutions network and is expected to deliver increased cost synergies of €32 million over three years.

evidence.title: Schumacher Packaging Western Europe Assets Acquisition

evidence.quote: On 31 March 2025, the Group completed the acquisition of the Western Europe Packaging Assets of Schumacher Packaging (Schumacher).

initiatives.name: Operational Excellence and Automation Programs
initiatives.summary: Mondi is accelerating operational excellence programmes with new initiatives driving productivity improvements across the value chain. The programs resulted in 5% productivity improvement across paper bag converting plants in 2025 and 3% efficiency improvement at a containerboard mill production line.

evidence.title: Operational Excellence Programs Accelerated

evidence.quote: We are accelerating our approach to operational excellence with new programmes driving a zero-loss productivity mindset and a disciplined, systematic way of operating.

initiatives.name: MAP2030 Sustainability Roadmap
initiatives.summary: Mondi updated several MAP2030 sustainability targets at the halfway point to 2030 to ensure they remain ambitious and relevant. The company extended its circular solutions target to 2030 and updated various environmental and social targets while maintaining core commitments.

evidence.title: Updated MAP2030 Sustainability Targets

initiatives.name: Capital Expenditure Cycle Adjustment
initiatives.summary: Following completion of recent expansion projects, Mondi's planned capital expenditure will fall to circa €550 million in 2026. The investment will focus on maintenance and targeted cost-optimization opportunities including enhancing energy efficiency and improving productivity.

evidence.title: Planned Capital Expenditure Reduction

evidence.quote: Given the conclusion of our recent expansion projects, our planned capital expenditure will fall to circa €550 million in 2026, focusing on maintenance and targeted cost-optimisation opportunities including enhancing energy efficiency, improving productivity and strengthening the resilience of our asset base.

initiatives.name: Business Unit Leadership Consolidation
initiatives.summary: Mondi combined two business units by bringing Uncoated Fine Paper under the same leadership as the Corrugated Packaging business unit. This creates a single management team and reduces indirect costs as part of operational efficiency improvements.

evidence.title: Business Unit Integration Program
evidence.summary: Mondi combined two business units by bringing Uncoated Fine Paper under the same leadership as the Corrugated Packaging business unit. This creates a single management team and reduces indirect costs as part of operational efficiency improvements.
evidence.quote: We also took the opportunity to combine two of our business units, bringing Uncoated Fine Paper under the same leadership as our Corrugated Packaging business unit, creating a single management team and reducing other indirect costs.

initiatives.name: Converting Plant Network Optimization
initiatives.summary: Mondi announced the closure of three converting sites in the last three months as part of network optimization efforts. The closures include a corrugated solutions plant in Türkiye and paper bag plants in Hungary and Germany, with production being transferred to more efficient plants in the network.

initiatives.name: Innovation Center Network Development
initiatives.summary: Mondi operates Customer Innovation Centers including one at Steinfeld in Germany and three 'ThinkBox' engagement centers across Europe. These facilities support customer co-development projects and innovative packaging solutions development.
